sources.observation: The lower terracotta cloister roofs contrast with the raised flat João III terrace. The Charola has tall stone buttresses and a crenellated eave.

sources.credit: Arlindo Homem / Museus e Monumentos de Portugal.
sources.observation: The west choir window uses twisted jambs, an irregular carved stone surround and an upper heraldic crest.

limitations: The convent exterior follows surveyed walls and courtyard outlines. Secondary roof subdivisions, the Manueline relief and the cloister steps are photo-based approximations. The separately mapped Tomar Castle and the aqueduct beyond the convent remain host features.
